- **README.md** covers the overview, installation (bench), development setup (pre-commit, semgrep) and links. Full product docs are external on DeepWiki (`deepwiki.com/Tacten/biograph`).
- **`wiki/`** holds the in-repo feature docs as Markdown, usually in pairs:
  - **Design documents** (`DESIGN-*.md`, `PATIENT-DUPLICATE.md`, `FHIR Terminology Service Parity — Implementation Plan.md`, `insurance-parity-report.md`) cover the overview, core features, data model and flows.
  - **User guides** (`*-USAGE*.md`) have an Introduction, a "This guide covers" list, a Quick Start with tables, and numbered steps that reference desk navigation such as **Healthcare > Patient Appointment**. Screenshots sit alongside, e.g. `patient-duplicatecheck-thumbnail.png`.
- **PR docs gate:** `docs_checker.yml` runs `.github/helper/documentation.py`. A PR whose title starts with `feat` must link to a `/wiki` URL on an approved docs host, or say `no-docs` (or `backport`) in its body. Otherwise the check fails.
- The PR template asks you to "Update necessary Documentation" and follow ERPNext's page-format guidelines.
- Agent docs: `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md` and `.build/RULES.md`. Build-managed guides go under `.build/guides/`.
